name: 에이전트 클럽하우스
description: 여러 coding agent가 한 대화에 참여하는 방. agents plugin의 정의에서 고른 member가 owned terminal session으로 시작하고, 방은 화자 label과 turn 규칙을 알린 뒤 mode와 @이름 mention에 따라 메시지를 전달한다.

kibitzDefault.label: 대화 기본 모드
kibitzDefault.description: 새 방의 대화 방식. 순차는 roster 순서로 member마다 차례로, 진행은 session이 idle인 첫 member가, 동시는 모든 member가 동시에 받는다. @이름 mention은 mention된 member에게만 보낸다.

conversationTurns.label: 대화 turn 한도
conversationTurns.description: owner 메시지 하나에서 mention과 continue round가 시작하는 turn의 최대 수. 기본값 48은 member 세 명의 round 16번으로, 계획 합의, 구현, 검증 보고를 거치는 개발 작업 하나에 맞춘 값이다. 한도만큼 진행되면 수렴하지 못했다고 적고 끝낸다.

maxMembers.label: team 최대 인원
maxMembers.description: leader가 member.summon으로 부를 수 있는 team member의 최대 수. 기본값 6은 leader 한 명이 brief하고 merge할 수 있는 병렬 worker 수다.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.arrangement
status.description: How the room arranged its member cards: idle before any arrangement, group when the room card and the member cards form one group card, tabs with the reason of the layout plan when the members open as tabs, and error with the reason of a refused layout command.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation
status.description: The conversation that the room shows: the entries of the room record in record order, speaker being owner, the identifier of a member, or clubhouse for a line of the room, and each member whose turn the room waits for, with its step (protocol until the protocol turn ends, turn while a turn line waits for a blocked session, answer until the answer arrives) and the program state of its session in core.sessions (null while core reports none, ended when core.sessions no longer lists it), and the session of each member with its sent and delivered numbers and the record lines that it has not received; each entry carries the sections of its answer, one per addressee, or [] without them, the record length and the number of record lines that its next turn line carries.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.view
status.description: The follow mode of the conversation view: following while the view is at the bottom and follows new entries, and unseen, the number (0 or more) of entries below the viewport that have not been visible since the person scrolled up; stopEnabled, whether the stop button is enabled, which it is only while a relay runs or a kept token is open.

status.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.transport
status.description: Whether the room can reach its members, with the reason when it cannot. The room has no member transport until the owned sessions and the terminal relay are in place, so its state is unavailable.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.state
commands.description: Return the live state of the room: the conversation mode, the roster with the check state of each member, and the transport status.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.set
commands.description: Check or uncheck the roster member id; checking invites it and summons its session. Setting the current state changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.leader
commands.description: Make the roster member id the leader when leader is true, check it and clear the leader of every other member, or clear it when leader is false. The leader receives every record line and settles the conversation.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.summon
commands.description: Summon a team member with the turn token of the leader: open a session of the agent definition with the role in the absolute directory, and answer after its protocol turn. Refused beyond the setting maxMembers.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.role
commands.description: Set the role of the roster member id, a text of 0 to 200 characters without control characters; the protocol line and each turn line state the roles. Setting the current role changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.member.move
commands.description: Move the roster member id to the place index, counted from 0.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mode.set
commands.description: Set the conversation mode of the room: facil, turn or simul.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.message.send
commands.description: Relay a message to the members by the mode and the mentions, let the members that answers mention take further turns up to the setting conversationTurns, and answer after the whole conversation with the answer of each member in turn order.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation.stop
commands.description: End the conversation of the message that the room relays: no further turn starts and a turn that waits for its answer ends without it; also end the wait of each token kept from before a restart. Refused when no message is relayed and no kept token is open. A second call changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.conversation.scroll.bottom
commands.description: Scroll the conversation view to its last entry and follow new entries again; the unseen count becomes 0. Calling it at the bottom changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.answer
commands.description: Deliver the answer of a member for the turn whose token its relayed line carries as [@clubhouse] turn <token>, with status continue while an open question, a disagreement or work remains, or settled when its part is done and verified; run it with the surface of the room. Each token takes one answer while its turn is open.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.report
commands.description: Report the work of a member during its open turn with the token of the turn and the paths it changed; a path outside the claims of the member in this turn is refused. The room records it as (report), and each other member reads it in its next turn line. The turn goes on.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.claim
commands.description: Claim paths for the member of the open turn before it edits them; refused with the holder when another member claims an overlapping path. The claims of a turn are released when the turn closes.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.release
commands.description: Release paths that the member of the open turn claims.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.set
commands.description: Open the control tower modal when open is true and close it when open is false. Setting the current state changes nothing.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.plan
commands.description: Turn a natural-language request into a validated command, DOM and status plan, returned as a dry run unless commit is true.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.reflect
commands.description: Plan, dispatch and verify a natural-language request, re-planning on failure up to a cap, then escalate.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.trace
commands.description: Return the persisted plan and step history of the control tower, newest first, or the steps of one plan.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.scan
commands.description: Scan untrusted text and plan steps for injection signatures and report the verdict.

commands.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower.macro
commands.description: Save, run, list, forget or propose a named control-tower macro.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.send
element.description: Send button: runs message.send with the text of the input. Disabled while the transport status is unavailable.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.stop
element.description: Stop button: runs conversation.stop, which ends the conversation and the waits of the kept tokens. Enabled only while a message is relayed or a kept token is open.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.pill
element.description: New-entry pill: shown in reading mode while entries below the viewport are unseen, with their number; a click runs conversation.scroll.bottom.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.input
element.description: Message input field: Enter without Shift runs message.send with its text. Disabled while the transport status is unavailable.

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tab
element.description: Roster tab of a member: a click runs member.set with the toggled state, a drag over another tab runs member.move

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.role
element.description: Role input of a roster member: a change runs member.role with the text of the input

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.mode
element.description: Conversation mode buttons (facilitator, sequential, simultaneous): each runs mode.set with its mode

element.name: soksak-plugin-agents-clubhouse.tower
element.description: Control tower button: runs tower.set with the state opposite to the current one, opening or closing the control tower modal (natural-language input, dry run, command templates, search, graph)
